protocol.updateRule: all valid sequenced source book updates; each exchange sequence used at most once
protocol.feature: top-of-book pressure sign from bid-quantity versus ask-quantity; fixed spread buckets; no fitted or swept thresholds
protocol.label: first later exchange-sequenced book with sourceAt >= decision observedAt + horizon; never use an earlier source clock
protocol.executableMarkouts: buy at signal ask then sell at later best bid; sell at signal bid then buy at later best ask; zero fees, no actual fill or order-latency claim
protocol.oneSpreadProxy: pressure-directed mid move minus the signal spread; exact ask-to-bid and bid-to-ask markouts include both observed top-of-book sides

limitations: This is a descriptive, overlapping-event markout study on one historical capture, not an independent profitability test.
A full book update and a later displayed opposite quote do not prove order acceptance, queue priority, fill quantity, or achievable execution latency.
The source capture was previously used for the 1-second microprice study; this is a frequency-resolution comparison, not untouched data.
Top-of-book pressure bins and spread buckets are predeclared; no thresholds or strategy parameters were tuned.
Rows overlap across time and markets. They are correlated observations, not independent trials or evidence of scalable capacity.
All monetary markouts are one-share displayed-price counterfactuals, zero fees, and exclude market impact.
